__comment: Placed by dwarves on any surface block with open sky (no ceiling within 10 blocks).
Only one recipe: 'collect_honey'. It takes no inputs — the bees do the work.
A dwarf is dispatched to the beehive once the production_interval has elapsed.
The task is auto-queued by the workshop manager; the player does not need to
manually schedule it. If no dwarf is available, honey accumulates in the hive
up to internal_capacity and is collected on the next available visit.
requires_open_sky: true  — same check as surface farm plots (no solid block
within 10 blocks directly above the hive block).
surface_only: true       — the block below the beehive must be a surface block
winter   — DORMANT; no honey is produced, auto-queue suspended.
The hive retains any uncollected honey across the dormant period.
